Welcome to the Git Workshop! 🎉

To automatically gain access to the organization and repository, please follow these steps carefully:

1. **Look at the Title:** At the top of this page, change the title by replacing `YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME` with your actual GitHub handle. 
2. **Do Not Remove the Prefix:** Ensure the title still starts with exactly `Onboard: ` (including the space).
3. **Submit:** Click the green **Submit new issue** button below.

Our automated pipeline will process your request, validate your username, and send you an invitation within a few seconds!
